verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own AI tools page describes Analytics AI (Intuit Intelligence), which explains in plain language which campaigns and automations drive revenue. It says recommendations are grounded in the store's real sales, campaigns and customer behavior, and Predictive Segmentation and Generative AI features appear on the pricing page. Missing for 10: in-depth help or docs on how the insights and suggestions work, any detail on which plans include them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Analytics AI, part of Mailchimp with Intuit Intelligence, explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue—and the plain-language reason why—so you can double down on what works.
every recommendation is grounded in your store’s real sales, campaigns, and customer behavior.
